objective: Preregister three candidates for individual-stock opening-range breakout filtered by opening relative volume ('Stocks in Play', Zarattini/Barbon/Aziz SSRN 4729284): SIP01 long-only at the paper's own eligibility parameters, SIP02 long-only at a stricter liquidity floor, SIP03 a long-short diagnostic (not promotable) for implementation-fidelity checking only -- plus a random-direction control (RD) and a random-non-in-play-liquid-stock control (RL), against the design window (2016-2022), the frozen select window (2023-09-18..2025-12-31), and an already-seen 2026 report window, before any backtest is run.

report_2026: already seen by several other directions this month; no holdout claim made here

rd_random_direction.description: RD: same daily top-20-by-relative-volume selection as the real candidate (same eligibility filters, same universe), but the traded direction is drawn randomly (+-1) instead of read from the opening candle's own close-vs-open -- isolates whether the direction call carries information versus just being in a volatile, abnormally-active name that day. 10 seeds, applied to SIP01's and SIP02's own eligible/selected sets separately.

rl_random_liquid_non_in_play.description: RL: same breakout/stop/exit mechanics and the same price/avg-volume/ATR eligibility filters as the real candidate, but instead of ranking by relative volume, 20 stocks are drawn at random from the eligible-but-NOT-real-top-20 set each day -- isolates whether the relative-volume ('in play') selection itself carries information versus generic breakout trading on liquid names. 10 seeds.

etf_orb_known_negative.description: No new simulation: dir:orb_etf_opening_range_breakout's already-refuted OOS numbers (QQQ -3.0%, SPY -6.0%, random-direction placebo capturing 92.7-92.9% of real return) are reused as a reference floor from reports/research/hypotheses/H-20260918-02-intraday-orb-and-intraday-momentum-etf.md and reports/research/lessons/L-20260918-02.md.

fixed_simulation_budget_next_step.description: For the NEXT (backtest) step: 3 candidates + 20 RD seeds (10 x SIP01, 10 x SIP02) + 20 RL seeds (10 x SIP01, 10 x SIP02) = 43 core simulations across the design and select windows; SIP03 is evaluated once (diagnostic, no seeds). Cost (5/10/20bp) and stop-fill-variant (conservative/one-bar-late) are reporting dimensions within each run, not separate manifest candidates.

design_window: (b) beats its own RD placebo median
(c) beats its own RL placebo median
(d) positive net of 20bp/side plus the $0.0035/share commission cross-check
select_window_frozen: (e) at 10bp: CAGR >= 50% and max drawdown >= -35% (gate G1)
(f) beats >= 90% of its combined RD+RL placebo draws (gate G3, <=10% placebo win rate)
adoption_rule.multiple_comparisons: 2 promotable candidates (SIP01, SIP02); SIP03 is never promotable
